resources.string: Decodes “%1$s” the way the sync will: 16 kHz mono, in 30 s windows. Measures time and memory.
Play a song stored on the phone first.

There are no lyrics to sync. Add or paste them first.
No sync model for this language yet (Italian and English are available).
The lyrics are longer than the song: are they the right ones?
Not enough memory on this phone. Close other apps and try again.
Not enough free space to download the voice model (about 350 MB).
The voice model could not be downloaded. It will resume from where it stopped next time.
Syncing on the phone: you can close the app, a notification shows the progress.
Another song is being synced: wait for it to finish.
Already synced: restored from the cache.
“Sync with the audio” times the lyrics word by word on the phone, without sending anything online. The voice model of each language is downloaded once (about 350 MB); after that it works offline.
Removes the music before listening (Spleeter, 26 MB). Better on loud mixes, about twice as slow.
Optimised CPU kernels; falls back automatically if the phone does not support them.
More is faster but warmer; the default leaves one core free for playback.
Not downloaded · %1$s, downloaded automatically when needed
Loads the model (downloads it the first time, ~350 MB), runs it on the first 15 s of the song and shows what it hears.
